answer: Tower data is cross-checked each epoch, and the claimed position must match the triangulation. Timing advance from nearby towers triangulates the device, and the proof binds it to a location. A farm in one room triangulates to one spot, so 175 aliases need 175 real locations. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the terrace signal is public, the anchor check is automatic, and 175 aliases cost 175 times what one real agent costs, with the signal trail open to all.
